row.name: Lekku Communication
row.description: Twi'leks can communicate subtly through precise movements of their lekku (head-tails). This allows for silent, private communication between Twi'leks (or those trained to understand) and can grant a +1 bonus to Fast-Talk or Diplomacy rolls when dealing with other Twi'leks. A powerful tool for covert operations, silent signals, or maintaining secrecy within a group.
